experiment: complete-fit RGB-DCT versus frozen skeleton robust predictor OOF

rgb_encoder.name: fixed-ycrcb-dct-v1
rgb_encoder.normalization: RGB uint8 -> YCrCb float32 / 255; orthonormal OpenCV DCT
rgb_encoder.crop: each hand from same-frame HRNet points confidence>=0.2; square 1.5xbbox, minimum 24 px; resize 32x32
rgb_encoder.invalid_crop: all 24 DCT coefficients and validity flag are zero; no future/past fill
rgb_encoder.output: 16 Y plus 4 Cr plus 4 Cb DCT coefficients and one validity flag per hand; 50/frame; float16 archive

temporal_visibility.decision: after offset3 candidate arrives; same bounded lookahead as K

feature_sets.B0: reuse frozen saved OOF score; 49 bookkeeping+decoder-prefix inputs
feature_sets.K: reuse frozen saved OOF score; B0 plus 68 skeleton-history summary inputs
feature_sets.R: B0 plus 200 RGB-DCT-history summary inputs; primary candidate
feature_sets.KR: B0 plus K and R histories; preregistered secondary complement diagnostic; not gate-eligible

folds: exact frozen robust-oof-v1 5-fold deterministic source mapping
normalization: mean/std independently fit on each OOF training fold only; no PCA/codebook

objectives.network: MLP 32-16; 20 fixed epochs; AdamW lr 0.002 weight_decay 0.0001; batch 8192

primary_comparison: R minus K signed top-K utility with source-cluster bootstrap 95% CI
KR_status: secondary diagnostic fixed now; cannot replace R as the confirmatory comparison or unlock closed loop
closed_loop_gate: R signed top-769 robust utility >=249 errors
forbidden: expensive ISLR logits or embeddings as R
